measured_from: The four Claude Code session transcripts for this project, in ~/.claude/projects/. Nothing here is estimated.

model.note: Opus 5 drove every session. Sonnet 5 ran the parallel subagents during the 12-step module build-out.

breakdown.label: Cache reads
breakdown.note: the project context re-read on every turn

tokens.note: 98.5% of the total is cache reads — the same project context re-read each turn, billed at a fraction of fresh input. The 1.92M output tokens are the number that maps to work produced.

mcp.note: No MCP server was ever called. The prototype has no external data source, no design file to sync and no live docs dependency, so every input stayed local.

memory.note: No entries were written to Claude's persistent memory store. Continuity across the four sessions came from PROJECT.md and CONVENTIONS.md instead — committed in-repo, so the decision record travels with the code and is reviewable rather than living in a private store.

skills.name: superpowers:brainstorming
skills.used_for: Turned each request into an approved written design before any code was written.

skills.name: superpowers:writing-plans
skills.used_for: Turned each approved design into a task-by-task plan with real test code and commit points.

skills.name: superpowers:executing-plans
skills.used_for: Ran those plans inline, verifying every task before moving to the next.

skills.name: superpowers:subagent-driven-development
skills.used_for: Ran independent plan tasks as fresh subagents during the 12-step module build-out.

skills.name: superpowers:using-git-worktrees
skills.used_for: Gave each feature an isolated workspace so half-finished work never sat on main.

skills.name: dataviz
skills.used_for: Set the chart form and colour rules. Its validated palette is what lib/chartColors.js ships — and it is why DEWA's brand green is not used as a chart-mark colour.

skills.name: artifact-design
skills.used_for: Calibrated how this prototype is published as a single self-contained shareable page.

skills.name: run
skills.used_for: Launched and drove the app in a real browser to confirm each change worked outside of tests.
